headline: Async standups without the meeting.
body: Share yesterday, today, and blockers asynchronously — when your team is ready.

footer.legal: Vibe Standup is part of Silver Vibe™, a personal open-source project (MIT).

my.title: My standup
my.lead: Draft, submit, and review today’s team summary.
my.noTeams: You are not on any team yet.
my.planHint: Voorbeeldabonnement {{plan}}: max. {{teams}} teams, {{members}} leden per team (alleen UI — API gebruikt echte rollen).

team.title: Team admin
team.lead: Configure standup questions, invite members, and rebuild summaries.
team.invitePending: Uitnodiging aangemaakt, maar e-mail is niet verstuurd (controleer RESEND_API_KEY). Kopieer de link hieronder.
team.inviteAccepted: Member added (they already had an account).
team.inviteEmailHint: We sturen de uitnodiging per e-mail als Resend is geconfigureerd. Je kunt de link altijd als backup kopiëren.
team.inviteEmailSent: Uitnodigingsmail verstuurd. Je kunt de link hieronder nog kopiëren indien nodig.
team.reminderHint: E-mails gaan op weekdagen in een venster van 15 minuten op dit lokale tijdstip.

workspace.title: Workspace admin
workspace.lead: Enable tools and create teams for this workspace.
workspace.planHint: Voorbeeldabonnement {{plan}}: max. {{teams}} teams, {{members}} leden per team (alleen UI — API gebruikt echte rollen).
workspace.slackHint: Autoriseer Slack eenmalig. Kies een kanaal bij installatie; samenvattingen worden daar gepost als addons.slack aan staat.
workspace.teamsHint: Paste a Microsoft Teams Incoming Webhook URL. When a team summary is rebuilt (submit or Rebuild), it posts to that channel if addons.teams is enabled.
workspace.slackOAuthUnavailable: Slack OAuth is nog niet geconfigureerd op de server.
workspace.linearConnected: Linear connected. Pick a project for digests.
workspace.linearHint: Authorize Linear once, then pick a project. Standup summaries post as project updates when addons.linear is enabled.
workspace.linearOAuthUnavailable: Linear OAuth is not configured on the server yet.
workspace.githubConnected: GitHub connected. Pick a repo and issue for digests.
workspace.githubHint: Authorize GitHub once, then pick a repository and open issue. Standup summaries post as issue comments when addons.github is enabled.
workspace.githubOAuthUnavailable: GitHub OAuth is not configured on the server yet.
workspace.jiraConnected: Jira connected. Pick a site, project, and issue for digests.
workspace.jiraHint: Authorize Atlassian once, then pick a site, project, and issue. Standup summaries post as issue comments when addons.jira is enabled.
workspace.jiraOAuthUnavailable: Jira OAuth is not configured on the server yet.
